correctness.rationale: The root-suppressed forcing closure is order-independent by persistence of any eligible move until its target colors. With root initially blue, precisely all branch types A or exactly one B succeed. With root initially white, at least one activation flag must be one before that root colors, and the same A/B condition then completes; configurations lacking activation have factored barred generating functions. Their sum is exactly the stated formula for every finite simple connected graph having the specified cut vertex. Independent direct enumeration confirms 1,974 rooted composites and 23 clique bouquets; it is not used in place of the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies the coefficient-refined cut-vertex decomposition sought in a concrete foundational open question and works across arbitrary connected branches. The correction for initially white cut vertices prevents naive multiplicative errors. It gives a reusable compositional invariant and exact formula for broad infinite families, independently of a finite table or routine specialization. Computational efficiency is not asserted.
